data.name: Helical RF resonator
data.function: Step-up resonator that raises the RF drive to the hundreds of volts needed on the trap rails while filtering amplitude noise; its quality factor and the RF amplitude stability determine the radial secular frequency stability, and through the mode frequencies the fidelity of every Mølmer–Sørensen gate.

physics.summary: RF voltage step-up and filtering for the trap.

data.tooltip: Helical resonator driving the trap RF.
